get.description: Admin or source-window owner. Returns current class details, scoped to the current assigned coach for coach callers. Source links survive window cancellation and class corrections.

post.description: Admin only. Creates a future lesson within the current submitted window using its coach and venue. requestId is stable across retries and unique per administrator. Matching retries return the current class (200), including after window changes; different payload reuse returns 409. New creation returns 201. Window edits/cancellation never change scheduled classes.

get.description: Notes shared with currently authorised student, guardians and coaches; administrators see all. Inaccessible student returns404. Ordered newest first.

post.description: Administrator or currently assigned coach. Actor-scoped requestId replays the same student/body with200; different payload reuse returns409. Saved notes are shared immediately.

patch.description: Author coach while still assigned, or administrator. Requires current version and correction reason; stale updates return409. Preserves original author and creation time, audits before/after/reason.

get.description: Administrator only; includes archived definitions, sorted by name then ID.

post.description: Administrator only. Exact actor-scoped request replay returns current definition with200; different original normalized inputs return409.

patch.description: Administrator only; current version and reason required. Stale version returns409. No hard deletion.

get.description: Currently scoped student only. Active definitions plus recorded archived definitions; history newest version first. No replay inputs exposed.

post.description: Assigned coach or administrator. Achievements require reviewed current skillVersion and optional comment; revocations require reason and current achievement author or administrator. Version0 initially. Revocation snapshots reversed achievement, independently of submitted skillVersion. Exact replay returns original event before transition checks after current access checks; changed normalized payload returns409. Archive blocks achievements only.
